I wrote `component.html` in the billing/5 folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows DESIGN.md and uses the tokens from `tokens.css`, copied inline so the file stands alone. Everything sits inside `#component`, 1280px wide, with static HTML and CSS only.

- **Page:** a white page with a centered 1120px column. "Billing" is the heading in Unbounded Light capitals.
- **Plan card:**
  - "Team plan" is the card title. "$24" is large, with "per seat per month" beside it in small muted text.
  - A thin bar under "18 of 25 seats used" shows 72% filled.
  - "Change Plan" is the one primary button, a 44px ink pill.
- **Invoices:** the heading, then a card holding the table. The table has a label-style header row, 52px rows and "Paid" in accent-tint pills.

- **Button placement:** DESIGN.md puts the screen's primary action in the top row on the right, but your content puts "Change Plan" inside the plan panel. I kept it in the panel and left the top row with only the heading, so the screen has one primary button.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the browser will show the system-ui fallback. The font tokens are set correctly and will pick up the real fonts if they're installed.
